historical_record.description: The commercial use of the property lost its non-conforming status and was declared illegal in 1965.

The building then on the lot had a used clothing store on the ground floor with apartments above; the premises had formerly been a paint store. The City Planning Commission disapproved, 7-0, reclassifying the property from R-2 to C-2.
